mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diet_meal_plan (user_id,plan_date,meal_period,meal_id,meal_snapshot,acquisition_mode,servings,status,created_at,updated_at) VALUES (#{userId},#{planDate},#{mealPeriod},#{mealId},#{mealSnapshot},#{acquisitionMode},#{servings},#{status},NOW(),NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE meal_id=VALUES(meal_id),meal_snapshot=VALUES(meal_snapshot), acquisition_mode=VALUES(acquisition_mode),servings=VALUES(servings),status=VALUES(status),updated_at=NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT FROM diet_meal_plan WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND plan_date=#{planDate} AND meal_period=#{mealPeriod}
SELECT FROM diet_meal_plan WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId}

SELECT FROM diet_meal_plan WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND plan_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} ORDER BY plan_date, CASE meal_period WHEN 'BREAKFAST' THEN 1 WHEN 'LUNCH' THEN 2 WHEN 'DINNER' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END
SELECT DISTINCT meal_id FROM diet_meal_plan WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND plan_date >= #{since} ORDER BY meal_id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM diet_meal_plan WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE diet_meal_plan SET status=#{status},updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diet_meal_checkin (user_id,plan_id,actual_meal_id,actual_meal_name,rating,satiety,reason_code,note,actual_spent,eaten_at,created_at,updated_at) VALUES (#{userId},#{planId},#{actualMealId},#{actualMealName},#{rating},#{satiety},#{reasonCode},#{note},#{actualSpent},#{eatenAt},NOW(),NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE actual_meal_id=VALUES(actual_meal_id),actual_meal_name=VALUES(actual_meal_name), rating=VALUES(rating),satiety=VALUES(satiety),reason_code=VALUES(reason_code),note=VALUES(note), actual_spent=VALUES(actual_spent),eaten_at=VALUES(eaten_at),updated_at=NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT id,user_id,plan_id,actual_meal_id,actual_meal_name,rating,satiety,reason_code,note,actual_spent,eaten_at,created_at,updated_at FROM diet_meal_checkin WHERE plan_id=#{planId} AND user_id=#{userId}
